name: Casper Mountain County Park - Archery Range Campground
note: Small Natrona County campground at the Robert L. Adams Memorial Archery Range Park on the southwest side of Casper Mountain, off Archery Range Road: sites under lodgepole pines, each with a fire pit and picnic table. The county publishes no site lengths, so confirm with the Parks Department that a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog (secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog, public getTabs/getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON, tab 12056 'Casper Mountain', group 24877 'Archery Range', read 2026-11-20): 'Closed for winter. Reopens 5/28/2027. Reservation only (up to 90 days in advance). The Robert L. Adams Memorial Archery Range Park, established in 1950s, is located on the southwest side of Casper Mountain. There are 4 campsites, each has a fire pit and a picnic table. $13.39 a day plus taxes and fees'; 4 bookable items AR Site 01-04, each a 2026 'Nightly Rate' of $13.39 with residency_restriction 'any' (sold by the night to the public, not a club or event-only area). Tab text: 'Casper Mountain Campgrounds are by reservation only ... You can picnic and camp from Beartrap Meadow on the east end of the mountain to Archery Range Park on the west'. visitcasper.com directory (read 2026-11-20): 'Casper Mountain offers six reservable campgrounds' managed by Natrona County Parks (Beartrap, Deer Haven, Elkhorn Springs, Skunk Hollow, Tower Hill and this one). Rec1 site photos (EXIF 2022-10-11): AR 1's sign stands beside a cleared dirt pad with table and fire ring under pines; AR 2-4 show only the site-number signs. County silent on rig length and no source shows pads under ~23 ft or tent-only/walk-in sites -> kept with an unclear-fit caveat (AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule); no agency road warning found (county pages 403, unread). Public (local): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World Imagery frames rendered at 42.72447,-106.35217 (~600 m and ~200 m half-widths), 42.7288,-106.3395 (~1.5 km) and 42.7242,-106.3525 (~110 m): Archery Range Road running SW through lodgepole forest on the mountain's west side, with a short dead-end spur and turnaround south of the road (a parked vehicle at its west end) in mixed pine and grassland; no lake, pond or stream visible anywhere in the 3 km frame. Rec1 describes no water. -> not waterfront.
fees_source: Rec1 group 24877 'Archery Range' ('$13.39 a day plus taxes and fees'); getLocationFacilities: all 4 sites 'Nightly Rate' base_fee 13.39, 2026-01-01..2026-12-31, read 2026-11-20.
sites_source: Rec1 group 24877 ('There are 4 campsites'; itemCount 4, items AR Site 01-04), read 2026-11-20.
hookups_source: Rec1 tab 12056 'Casper Mountain' ('Water is not available at any of the Casper Mountain Campgrounds.'), read 2026-11-20. Electric not stated for this campground.

facilities.note: Restroom provided; no water at any Casper Mountain campground.

facilities_source: Rec1 tab 12056 ('Restroom facilities are provided at each Casper Mountain Campground. Water is not available at any of the Casper Mountain Campgrounds.'), read 2026-11-20. Toilet type (vault/flush) not stated.

season.note: Reopens May 28, 2027; the county does not publish a closing date.

season_source: Rec1 group 24877 ('Closed for winter. Reopens 5/28/2027.'), read 2026-11-20.

booking.note: Reservation only, online (Rec1) or through the county Parks Department.

booking_source: Rec1 group 24877 ('Reservation only (up to 90 days in advance)') + tab 12056 ('Casper Mountain Campgrounds are by reservation only'); Rec1 site photos (AR Site 01-04, EXIF 2022-10-11) show each site's sign 'AR n / 10 DAY CAMPING LIMIT / ENJOY YOUR STAY / RESERVATIONS REQUIRED', read 2026-11-20.
flags: Rig fit unverified: the county publishes no site lengths and its campground map (natronacounty-wy.gov DocumentCenter/View/6374/ArcheryRange_041321, linked from the Rec1 group) was not fetched (site refuses). Only AR 1's photo shows ground: a cleared dirt pad beside the sign. No third-party listing (The Dyrt, Campendium, campgroundviews) or review was found for this campground at all, so drive-in RV use rests on the county's site photos and imagery. Kept with a caveat under the AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule; with 4 sites and no camper report, the reviewer may prefer to hold it.

Pin is a judgement: the county's 'Directions to Archery Range Campground' link resolves to a Google road point on Archery Range Rd (42.7244655,-106.352169), not a place. Moved ~60 m S onto the dead-end spur and turnaround below the road, the only campground-shaped road nearby; sites are not visible under the canopy. Google's separate 'Robert adams archery range' pin (42.7330,-106.3267, no rating) sits ~2.3 km NE in forest near a building cluster and does not match the county's 'southwest side of Casper Mountain'; not used.
Not a duplicate: ~3.2 km W of 6530 Beartrap and ~3.2-3.7 km from 15733-15736; nothing else in the DB within 5 km; a separately named Rec1 facility with its own 4 sites (AR 01-04).
No Google rating for the campground itself (gm.py found only the Casper Mountain Park listing, 4.6 on 125, which is not this campground's).
Electric and toilet type not stated for this campground, so hookups carries water false only and facilities potable_water false only (as 15734 Elkhorn Springs).
